bio.text: Frank Pallone represents New Jersey's 6th Congressional District and is the top Democrat on the House Energy and Commerce Committee, which he chaired in the 117th Congress.
He was elected to the U.S. House on November 8, 1988, and has represented the 6th District since 1992.
He began his political career on the Long Branch City Council in 1982 and was elected to the New Jersey Senate in 1983.
He was born in Long Branch, where he still lives.
